items.title: γ-transcranial alternating current stimulation improves upper-limb motor function in stroke patients and modulates oscillatory imbalance: a pilot randomized controlled trial | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A pilot randomized controlled trial demonstrated that γ-transcranial alternating current stimulation improved upper-limb motor function in stroke patients and modulated oscillatory imbalance.
items.curatedReason: 一项小型 RCT 显示，γ-经颅交流电刺激 (γ-tACS) 可改善卒中患者的上肢运动功能并调节皮层振荡失衡。这提示 tACS 可能成为神经调控干预的新方向，但鉴于样本量小，短期内别急于推广。
items.titleZh: γ-经颅交流电刺激改善卒中患者上肢运动功能并调节振荡失衡：一项前瞻性随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项试点随机对照试验显示，γ-经颅交流电刺激改善了卒中患者的上肢运动功能并调节了振荡失衡。
items.curatedReasonEn: A small RCT suggests that γ-transcranial alternating current stimulation (γ-tACS) may improve upper-limb motor function and modulate oscillatory imbalance in stroke patients. This indicates tACS could be a new direction for neuro-modulation interventions, but given the small sample size, do not rush to widespread adoption.
items.limitation: 这是一项初步的试点 RCT，样本量小，需要更大规模的研究来验证其疗效和长期效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot RCT with a small sample size, requiring larger studies to validate its efficacy and long-term effects.

items.title: The effect of an eight-week FIFA 11+ program on the landing error scoring system following functional fatigue in adolescent female soccer players with dynamic knee valgus | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: An eight-week FIFA 11+ program significantly improved the Landing Error Scoring System (LESS) following functional fatigue in adolescent female soccer players with dynamic knee valgus.
items.curatedReason: FIFA 11+ 方案可改善青少年女性足球运动员在功能性疲劳后的着陆错误评分系统（LESS），这对于降低 ACL 损伤风险至关重要。将此方案纳入青少年女性运动员的训练常规，有助于提高预防效果。
items.titleZh: 八周 FIFA 11+ 方案对青少年女性足球运动员动态膝外翻功能性疲劳后着陆错误评分系统的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现，为期八周的 FIFA 11+ 方案显著改善了青少年女性足球运动员在动态膝外翻和功能性疲劳后的着陆错误评分系统（LESS）表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: The FIFA 11+ program can improve the Landing Error Scoring System (LESS) after functional fatigue in adolescent female soccer players, which is crucial for reducing ACL injury risk. Incorporating this program into adolescent female athletes' training routines can enhance prevention effectiveness.
items.limitation: 研究虽然是随机对照试验，但只评估了 8 周干预的短期效果，缺乏长期随访数据来确认 ACL 损伤发生率的实际降低。
items.limitationEn: Although a randomized controlled trial, the study only evaluated the short-term effects of an 8-week intervention, lacking long-term follow-up data to confirm an actual reduction in ACL injury incidence.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Action observation therapy in pediatric cerebral palsy: an fNIRS-based investigation of cortical responses and balance—a randomized controlled trial - Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated the effects of action observation therapy (AOT) on cortical responses and balance in pediatric cerebral palsy patients using fNIRS, finding improvements in balance.
items.curatedReason: 在小儿脑瘫患者的康复中，动作观察疗法（AOT）不只改善平衡，这项 RCT 还用 fNIRS 证实了它能调节皮层反应。这支持了 AOT 作为一种非侵入性神经康复手段，并可能为你开辟新的干预思路。
items.titleZh: 小儿脑瘫动作观察疗法：基于 fNNIRS 的皮层反应和平衡研究——一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验利用 fNIRS 研究了动作观察疗法（AOT）对小儿脑瘫患者皮层反应和平衡的影响，发现平衡有所改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: In pediatric cerebral palsy rehabilitation, Action Observation Therapy (AOT) doesn't just improve balance; this RCT, using fNIRS, confirms it also modulates cortical responses. This supports AOT as a non-invasive neurorehabilitation tool and may open new avenues for intervention.
items.limitation: 这项 RCT 是基于 fNIRS 的试点研究，样本量和随访时间有限，需要更大规模的研究来确证其长期临床疗效。
items.limitationEn: This fNIRS-based pilot RCT has a limited sample size and follow-up period, and larger studies are needed to confirm its long-term clinical efficacy.

items.title: Handgrip and leg strength and risk of severe fall injuries in adults aged ≥ 80 years: a prospective HUNT study | BMC Geriatrics
items.summary: A prospective HUNT study found that handgrip and leg strength were associated with the risk of severe fall injuries in adults aged 80 years and older.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性 HUNT 研究发现，80 岁及以上老年人的握力和腿部力量与严重跌倒损伤风险相关。这强调了你作为物理治疗师，在对极高龄患者进行跌倒风险评估时，应高度关注这些基础力量指标。
items.titleZh: 80 岁及以上成年人握力和腿部力量与严重跌倒损伤风险：一项前瞻性 HUNT 研究
items.summaryZh: 一项前瞻性 HUNT 研究发现，80 岁及以上成年人的握力和腿部力量与严重跌倒损伤风险相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective HUNT study found that handgrip and leg strength are associated with the risk of severe fall injuries in adults aged 80 years and older. This emphasizes that as a physical therapist, you should pay close attention to these basic strength indicators when assessing fall risk in very elderly patients.
items.limitation: 研究仅建立了力量与跌倒损伤风险的关联性，无法确立因果关系，也未直接评估干预措施的效果。
items.limitationEn: The study only established an association between strength and fall injury risk, without establishing causality or directly evaluating intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Bypass neural interfaces for paralysis: clinical translation, challenges and future directions | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A review explored the clinical translation, challenges, and future directions of bypass neural interfaces for paralysis, which re-establish functional communication across disrupted neural pathways.
items.curatedReason: 旁路神经接口技术在瘫痪康复中的临床转化、挑战和未来方向的综述，对理解先进神经工程在神经康复中的潜力很有价值。它展示了未来 PT 实践与高科技结合的可能性。
items.titleZh: 瘫痪旁路神经接口：临床转化、挑战与未来方向
items.summaryZh: 一篇综述探讨了旁路神经接口用于瘫痪的临床转化、挑战和未来方向，这些接口重建了受损神经通路的功能性交流。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review of bypass neural interfaces for paralysis, covering clinical translation, challenges, and future directions, is valuable for understanding the potential of advanced neuroengineering in neurological rehabilitation. It demonstrates the future possibilities of PT practice integrating with high technology.
items.limitation: 这是一篇综述，主要关注技术进展和潜力，缺乏具体临床疗效的量化数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a review focused on technological advancements and potential, lacking quantitative data on specific clinical efficacy.

items.title: Predictors of discharge destination of stroke patients from inpatient rehabilitation center, including difficult discharge cases | Egyptian Rheumatology and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A research study investigated predictors of discharge destination for stroke patients from inpatient rehabilitation centers, including factors contributing to difficult discharge cases.
items.curatedReason: 预测卒中患者从住院康复中心出院目的地，包括出院困难病例的因素，对优化康复路径和资源分配具有重要意义。这有助于你更好地为患者规划出院方案。
items.titleZh: 卒中患者出院目的地预测因素，包括困难出院病例
items.summaryZh: 一项研究调查了卒中患者从住院康复中心出院目的地的预测因素，包括导致困难出院病例的因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Identifying predictors of discharge destination for stroke patients from inpatient rehabilitation centers, including difficult discharge cases, is crucial for optimizing rehabilitation pathways and resource allocation. This helps you better plan discharge options for patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究，可能存在混杂因素，且其结果需要多中心、大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study, which may have confounding factors, and its results require validation through multi-center, large-scale studies.

items.title: Diagnostic accuracy of biodex balance system stability indices under single- and dual-task conditions in individuals with chronic ankle instability | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A research study investigated the diagnostic accuracy of Biodex balance system stability indices under single- and dual-task conditions in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.curatedReason: Biodex 平衡系统在单任务和双任务条件下，对慢性踝关节不稳（CAI）患者的诊断准确性研究，有助于你更好地评估 CAI 患者的平衡缺陷，尤其是在动态和认知负荷下的表现。这能提升临床评估的精细度。
items.titleZh: Biodex 平衡系统稳定性指标在慢性踝关节不稳患者单任务和双任务条件下的诊断准确性
items.summaryZh: 一项研究调查了 Biodex 平衡系统稳定性指标在单任务和双任务条件下，对慢性踝关节不稳（CAI）患者的诊断准确性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Research on the diagnostic accuracy of Biodex balance system stability indices under single- and dual-task conditions for chronic ankle instability (CAI) helps you better assess balance deficits in CAI patients, especially under dynamic and cognitive loads. This can enhance the precision of clinical evaluation.
items.limitation: 本研究是一项观察性研究，评估的是诊断准确性，而非干预效果，且受试者样本量有限。
items.limitationEn: This observational study assessed diagnostic accuracy, not intervention effectiveness, and had a limited sample size.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Distinct Movement-Related Cortical Control Following Anterior Cruciate Ligament Injury: A Scoping Review | Sports Medicine - Open
items.summary: A scoping review synthesized evidence on distinct brain activity and its impact on motor performance during motor tasks in anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) patients.
items.curatedReason: ACL 损伤后的运动功能障碍，可能不只是关节本身的问题。这份综述提示，大脑皮层活动的变化也扮演了角色，这提醒你在康复时，别只盯着外周，神经层面的干预或许也是重要一环。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带损伤后独特的运动相关皮层控制：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述综合了关于前交叉韧带（ACL）损伤患者在运动任务期间独特的脑活动及其对运动表现影响的证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: Motor dysfunction after ACL injury might not solely be a joint issue. This review suggests altered brain activity also plays a role, reminding you not to focus solely on peripheral issues during rehabilitation; neural interventions may be an important component.
items.limitation: 这是一项范围综述，主要侧重于文献的识别和总结，而非对证据的质量进行严格评估或进行荟萃分析。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, primarily focused on identifying and summarizing literature, rather than rigorously assessing evidence quality or conducting meta-analysis.

items.title: Outcome indicators and effectiveness of nutrition education for athletes: a systematic review | BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A systematic review assessed outcome indicators and the effectiveness of nutrition education for athletes, aiming to improve health, nutritional status, and support athletic sustainability.
items.curatedReason: 为运动员提供营养教育，关键在于知道什么有效。这项系统综述为你指明了方向：了解哪些营养教育方法能真正改善健康和运动表现，并学会如何评估其效果，以设计更科学的跨学科支持。
items.titleZh: 运动员营养教育的结局指标和有效性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述评估了运动员营养教育的结局指标和有效性，旨在改善健康、营养状况并支持运动的可持续性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review evaluates the effectiveness and outcome indicators of nutrition education for athletes, which is crucial for you to understand what interventions are effective and how to measure their success when providing nutrition counseling and education to athletes. This helps you design more effective interdisciplinary support programs.
items.limitation: 作为系统综述，其结论受限于纳入研究的质量和异质性，可能无法给出统一的、强有力的干预建议。
items.limitationEn: As a systematic review, its conclusions are limited by the quality and heterogeneity of included studies, potentially preventing uniform, strong intervention recommendations.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Biomechanical effects of powered knee orthoses and articulated ankle-foot orthoses in people with diparetic cerebral palsy: a pilot study | Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A pilot study investigated the biomechanical effects of powered knee orthoses and articulated ankle-foot orthoses in people with diparetic cerebral palsy, who often exhibit gait impairments like excessive knee flexion and ankle dorsiflexion.
items.curatedReason: 这项初步研究揭示了动力膝关节矫形器和踝足矫形器（AFO）在双瘫型脑瘫患者中的生物力学效应。这为选择合适的辅助装置提供了初步证据，有助于你根据个体步态障碍特点定制矫形器方案。
items.titleZh: 动力膝关节矫形器和踝足矫形器对双瘫型脑瘫患者的生物力学效应：一项试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项试点研究调查了动力膝关节矫形器和踝足矫形器对双瘫型脑瘫患者的生物力学效应，这些患者常表现出膝关节过度屈曲和踝关节背屈过大等步态障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study reveals the biomechanical effects of powered knee orthoses and articulated ankle-foot orthoses (AFOs) in individuals with diparetic cerebral palsy. This provides preliminary evidence for selecting appropriate assistive devices, helping you customize orthosis plans based on individual gait impairment characteristics.
items.limitation: 这是一项试点研究，样本量小，且只报告了短期的生物力学效应，缺乏长期临床功能改善的证据。
items.limitationEn: This is a pilot study with a small sample size, reporting only short-term biomechanical effects and lacking evidence of long-term clinical functional improvement.

items.title: Characterization of physical health variables across fall risk appraisal groups: a cross-sectional study | BMC Geriatrics
items.summary: A cross-sectional study characterized physical health variables across different fall risk appraisal groups, aiming to understand factors related to fall risk in older adults.
items.curatedReason: 不同跌倒风险评估组的老年人，其身体健康变量特征各不相同。这项横断面研究提醒你，在制定跌倒预防策略时，不能一概而论，应根据患者具体的风险评估结果，更精细地匹配干预措施。
items.titleZh: 不同跌倒风险评估组身体健康变量的特征：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究描述了不同跌倒风险评估组的身体健康变量特征，旨在了解老年人跌倒风险相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Older adults in different fall risk appraisal groups exhibit distinct physical health variable characteristics. This cross-sectional study reminds you that fall prevention strategies should not be one-size-fits-all; instead, interventions must be more precisely tailored to each patient's specific risk assessment.
items.limitation: 作为横断面研究，本研究仅描述了跌倒风险组间的变量差异，无法推断因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it only describes variable differences between fall risk groups and cannot infer causality.

items.title: Low-load blood flow restriction training vs high-load resistance training for sarcopenia in older adults: a literature review | Sport Sciences for Health
items.summary: A literature review compared low-load blood flow restriction training (BFRT) with high-load resistance training for sarcopenia in older adults, addressing the challenge of muscle strength and mass maintenance.
items.curatedReason: 对于无法承受高负荷的老年肌少症患者，BFRT 是一个有前景的替代方案，能有效维持肌肉力量和质量。在临床实践中，当你遇到这类患者时，可以考虑将低负荷 BFRT 纳入治疗计划。
items.titleZh: 低负荷血流限制训练与高负荷阻力训练治疗老年肌少症：一项文献综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇文献综述比较了低负荷血流限制训练（BFRT）与高负荷阻力训练在老年肌少症患者中的应用，旨在解决肌肉力量和质量维持的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: For older adults with sarcopenia who cannot tolerate high-load resistance training, BFRT presents a promising alternative for maintaining muscle strength and mass. You should consider integrating low-load BFRT into treatment plans for these patients when appropriate.
items.limitation: 作为文献综述，其结论的强度受限于所纳入研究的质量和异质性，缺乏荟萃分析的量化结果。
items.limitationEn: As a literature review, the strength of its conclusions is limited by the quality and heterogeneity of the included studies, lacking quantitative results from a meta-analysis.

items.title: Hamstring fascicle behavior during leg curl exercises performed at varying knee joint angles and loading intensities in individuals with a history of unilateral hamstring injury: a randomized cross-over design study
items.summary: A randomized cross-over design study examined hamstring fascicle behavior during leg curl exercises performed at varying knee joint angles and loading intensities in individuals with a history of unilateral hamstring injury.
items.curatedReason: 单侧腘绳肌损伤史的患者，他们在腿弯举时的筋束行为会因膝关节角度和负荷强度而异。这项 RCT 告诉你，为这类患者设计训练方案时，你需要更精细地调整参数，以期达到最佳康复效果。
items.titleZh: 单侧腘绳肌损伤史患者在不同膝关节角度和负荷强度下进行腿弯举时腘绳肌筋束行为的研究：一项随机交叉设计研究
items.summaryZh: 一项随机交叉设计研究调查了有单侧腘绳肌损伤史的个体在不同膝关节角度和负荷强度下进行腿弯举时，腘绳肌筋束的行为。
items.curatedReasonEn: For individuals with a history of unilateral hamstring injury, fascicle behavior during leg curls varies with knee joint angle and load intensity. This RCT indicates you need to finely tune these parameters when designing training programs for these patients to achieve optimal rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究设计是交叉试验，可能存在学习效应或残余效应，且仅关注筋束行为，未直接评估临床结局。
items.limitationEn: The study design is a crossover trial, which may have learning or carryover effects, and focused only on fascicle behavior, without directly assessing clinical outcomes.

items.title: Effects of multimodal balance training with and without auditory cues on balance, gait mobility, risk of fall and quality of life in patients with chronic stroke
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 42 chronic stroke survivors found that multimodal balance training combined with auditory cues may improve balance, gait mobility, fall risk, and quality of life more effectively than the same training without auditory cues.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性卒中患者，多模式平衡训练结合听觉提示可能在改善平衡、步态移动、降低跌倒风险和生活质量方面比单纯训练更有效。这个小样本 RCT 提示了多感官整合在神经康复中的潜力，值得你在设计个性化训练方案时考虑。
items.titleZh: 多模式平衡训练结合/不结合听觉提示对慢性卒中患者平衡、步态移动、跌倒风险和生活质量的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 42 名慢性卒中幸存者的随机对照试验发现，结合听觉提示的多模式平衡训练在改善平衡、步态移动、跌倒风险和生活质量方面可能比不结合听觉提示的训练更有效。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic stroke patients, multimodal balance training with auditory cues may be more effective than training alone in improving balance, gait mobility, fall risk, and quality of life. This small-sample RCT suggests the potential of multisensory integration in neurorehabilitation, worth considering when designing personalized training programs.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（42 名参与者），且为单中心研究，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (42 participants) and is single-center, limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Advancing spine connectomics and neural integration through machine learning and neuroengineering: a narrative review.
items.summary: A narrative review summarizes recent advances in spinal circuitry, emphasizing machine learning and neuroengineering, suggesting the spinal cord is an active system contributing to sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control.
items.curatedReason: 我们是时候更新对脊髓的认知了：它绝不仅仅是反射弧的传导通路，而是一个主动参与感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制的复杂系统。未来脊髓损伤的康复干预，很可能会从靶向特定神经回路入手。
items.titleZh: 机器学习和神经工程推动脊柱连接组学和神经整合研究进展：叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述总结了脊髓回路研究的最新进展，重点介绍了机器学习和神经工程的应用，表明脊髓是一个积极参与感觉运动整合和适应性运动控制的系统。
items.curatedReasonEn: It's time to update our understanding of the spinal cord: it's far more than just a reflex arc conduit, actively engaging in sensorimotor integration and adaptive motor control. Future neurorehabilitation for spinal cord injuries will likely target specific neural circuits.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且未进行系统性证据评估。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, it may be subject to selection bias and does not involve systematic evidence appraisal.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Factors Explaining Limited Daily Hand-use in Individuals with Fair-Good Motor Ability Post-Stroke.
items.summary: A cross-sectional study identified factors explaining limited daily hand-use in individuals post-stroke with fair-to-good motor ability, including proprioception, executive functions, and self-efficacy, beyond motor impairment.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，即便卒中患者上肢运动能力良好，其日常手部使用受限的原因可能超出运动障碍本身。它指出了本体感觉、执行功能和自我效能等因素的重要性，这有助于你进行更全面的评估和干预。
items.titleZh: 解释卒中后运动能力良好个体日常手部使用受限的因素
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，即使卒中后个体上肢运动能力良好，其日常手部使用受限的解释因素可能超出运动障碍，包括本体感觉、执行功能和自我效能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that even in stroke patients with fair-to-good upper extremity motor ability, limited daily hand use may stem from factors beyond motor impairment. It highlights the importance of proprioception, executive functions, and self-efficacy, which can aid in your comprehensive assessment and intervention planning.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在自我报告偏倚。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality and may be subject to self-report bias.

items.title: Lifestyle medicine innovations: Physical activity assessment in patient care and implementation of a digital health platform to support healthier movement.
items.summary: A narrative review introduces the ExerciseRxTM digital health platform as a scalable approach for personalized physical activity and home exercise support in clinical care, integrating physical activity vital signs.
items.curatedReason: ExerciseRxTM 平台提供了一个可参考的范例，说明如何将患者的身体活动视为“生命体征”之一，并将其整合到日常临床护理中。如果你正在探索数字化工具来优化患者居家锻炼和生活方式干预，可以关注其设计理念。
items.titleZh: 生活方式医学创新：患者护理中的身体活动评估及数字健康平台实施以支持更健康的运动
items.summaryZh: 一篇叙述性综述介绍了 ExerciseRxTM 数字健康平台，作为一种可扩展的方法，用于在临床护理中支持个性化身体活动和家庭锻炼，并整合了身体活动生命体征。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ExerciseRxTM platform offers a blueprint for treating physical activity as a 'vital sign' and integrating it into routine clinical care. If you're exploring digital tools to optimize patient home exercise and lifestyle interventions, pay attention to its design philosophy.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且对平台效果的报告处于早期研究阶段。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, it may be subject to selection bias, and the reported platform effects are in early research stages.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: O’Halloran Rehabilitation Monetizes Complex Care and Protects Revenue with WebPT SOAP 2.0
items.summary: O'Halloran Rehabilitation successfully leveraged WebPT SOAP 2.0 to manage complex care and protect revenue, demonstrating the benefits of specialized EMR systems for physical therapy practices.
items.curatedReason: 了解物理治疗 EMR 系统的市场应用案例，对你评估是否引入或优化现有系统有帮助。
items.titleZh: O’Halloran Rehabilitation 利用 WebPT SOAP 2.0 实现复杂护理变现并保护收入
items.summaryZh: O’Halloran Rehabilitation 成功利用 WebPT SOAP 2.0 系统管理复杂护理并保护收入，展示了专业 EMR 系统对物理治疗实践的益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: Understanding market use cases for physical therapy EMR systems can help you evaluate whether to adopt or optimize your current system.

items.title: Effectiveness of different modes of digital health interventions for sarcopenia in older adults: a systematic review and network meta-analysis | BMC Geriatrics
items.summary: A systematic review and network meta-analysis evaluated the effectiveness of different modes of digital health interventions for sarcopenia in older adults.
items.curatedReason: 数字健康干预对老年肌少症患者的有效性，这项系统综述和网络Meta分析为你提供了不同模式的相对疗效证据。你可以根据这些发现，选择最适合患者的数字化康复方案。
items.titleZh: 不同模式数字健康干预对老年肌少症患者的有效性：一项系统综述和网络Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和网络Meta分析评估了不同模式数字健康干预对老年肌少症患者的有效性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review and network meta-analysis clarifies the effectiveness of various digital health intervention modes for sarcopenia in older adults. When designing digital rehabilitation programs for your patients, select the most suitable mode based on this evidence.
items.limitation: 网络Meta分析的比较结果受限于不同数字干预模式之间的研究数量和异质性。
items.limitationEn: The comparative results of network meta-analysis are limited by the number and heterogeneity of studies across different digital intervention modes.

items.title: Effects of resistance-band shoulder exercise on pain, range of motion, and functional disability in diabetic adults with adhesive capsulitis: a pilot randomized controlled trial | BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders

items.summary: This case-control study of 30 stroke patients and 30 matched controls found that stroke patients had significantly higher total Arizona Sexual Experience Scale scores (19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001) and a higher prevalence of sexual dysfunction (p = 0.004), alongside declines in sexual satisfaction.
items.curatedReason: 卒中患者的性功能障碍显著高于对照组，且与抑郁、焦虑和生活质量显著相关。在康复计划中，别忘了纳入对性健康和心理健康的评估与干预，这会显著影响患者的生活质量和依从性。
items.titleZh: 中青年卒中患者抑郁、焦虑、生活质量与性功能障碍的关联：一项病例对照研究
items.summaryZh: 这项纳入 30 名卒中患者和 30 名匹配对照的病例对照研究发现，卒中患者的性经历量表总分显著更高（19.3 ± 6.6 vs. 13.0 ± 3.1, p < 0.001），性功能障碍患病率更高（p = 0.004），且性满意度显著下降。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stroke patients experience significantly higher rates of sexual dysfunction compared to controls, and this is strongly associated with depression, anxiety, and quality of life. Ensure your rehabilitation plans include assessment and intervention for sexual and psychological health, as this can significantly impact patient quality of life and adherence.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本量（n=30）的病例对照研究，结果的外推性有限，且无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a small case-control study (n=30), limiting generalizability and preventing the establishment of causality.

items.title: ACCESS for Primary Care Providers and Referring Clinicians
items.summary: The CMS Innovation Center launched the ACCESS model, a 10-year pilot offering ongoing, technology-supported chronic care from Medicare-enrolled providers at low or no cost to patients.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 创新中心推出了 ACCESS 模式，旨在通过技术支持的慢性病护理，补充初级保健和转诊服务。这将为 PT 提供新的转诊机会和远程监测手段，你应了解如何整合到你的执业中。
items.titleZh: 面向初级保健提供者和转诊临床医师的ACCESS项目
items.summaryZh: CMS创新中心推出了ACCESS模式，这是一个为期10年的试点项目，由 Medicare 注册医疗服务提供者为患者提供持续的、技术支持的慢性护理，费用低廉或免费。
items.curatedReasonEn: The U.S. CMS Innovation Center has launched the ACCESS model, aiming to supplement primary care and referral services with technology-supported chronic care. This will open new referral opportunities and remote monitoring avenues for PTs; you should understand how to integrate this into your practice.

items.title: Cost-effectiveness of stratified physiotherapy integrated with digital health versus usual physiotherapy for neck and/or shoulder pain: results of a cluster randomised clinical trial.
items.summary: A cluster randomized clinical trial found that a Stratified Blended Physiotherapy Approach (SBPA), integrating prognostic risk stratification with digital health, was cost-effective compared to usual physiotherapy for 136 patients with neck and/or shoulder pain.
items.curatedReason: 分层融合物理治疗（结合风险分层和数字健康）在颈肩痛患者中，不仅临床效果不劣于常规物理治疗，成本效益也更好。这意味着你可以开始考虑在临床实践中更积极地整合基于风险分层的数字健康工具，尤其是在资源有限的初级诊疗环境。
items.titleZh: 分层融合物理治疗结合数字健康对颈肩痛的成本效益：一项整群随机临床试验结果
items.summaryZh: 一项整群随机临床试验评估了分层融合物理治疗（SBPA，结合预后风险分层与数字健康）与常规物理治疗相比，对 136 名颈肩痛患者的成本效益。结果显示 SBPA 具有成本效益。
items.curatedReasonEn: Stratified blended physiotherapy (combining risk stratification with digital health) for neck and shoulder pain is not only clinically non-inferior to usual physiotherapy but also more cost-effective. This suggests you can start considering more active integration of risk-stratified digital health tools into your practice, especially in resource-limited primary care settings.
items.limitation: 本研究的患者样本量相对较小，且仅在荷兰初级诊疗环境进行，结果的外推性需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The relatively small patient sample size and its focus on a primary care setting in the Netherlands may limit the generalizability of these findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Positive Psychology Interventions for Adults with Spinal Cord Injury: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of eight studies published between 2000 and 2025 indicated that positive psychology interventions (PPIs) may improve health and well-being outcomes in adults with spinal cord injury.
items.curatedReason: 积极心理学干预对脊髓损伤患者的心理健康和幸福感有潜在益处。虽然证据仍在早期阶段，你可以关注这类非传统干预，作为全面康复计划的辅助手段，尤其是在患者心理调适方面。
items.titleZh: 积极心理学干预对脊髓损伤成人患者的影响：一项系统综述和 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和 Meta 分析纳入了 2000 年至 2025 年间发表的 8 项研究，旨在评估积极心理学干预（PPIs）对脊髓损伤（SCI）成人患者健康和幸福结局的影响，结果提示 PPIs 可能带来改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: Positive psychology interventions show potential benefits for mental health and well-being in adults with spinal cord injury. While evidence is still emerging, you can consider these non-traditional interventions as adjuncts to comprehensive rehabilitation plans, especially for psychological adjustment.
items.limitation: 纳入的试验数量较少（8项），且干预措施和结果指标可能存在异质性，影响汇总结果的稳健性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included studies (8) and potential heterogeneity in interventions and outcome measures may affect the robustness of the pooled results.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Changes in Urgency Urinary Incontinence Symptoms After Stress Urinary Incontinence Surgery in Women | International Urogynecology Journal
items.summary: An observational study investigated changes in urgency urinary incontinence symptoms after stress urinary incontinence surgery in women, noting potential improvements, worsening, or de novo onset.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究发现压力性尿失禁手术可能改善或加重急迫性尿失禁症状，甚至引起新发症状。在术前咨询时，务必告知患者这些潜在风险，并强调术后对急迫性症状的持续评估和管理的重要性。
items.titleZh: 女性压力性尿失禁手术后急迫性尿失禁症状的变化
items.summaryZh: 一项观察性研究探讨了女性压力性尿失禁手术后急迫性尿失禁症状的变化，指出可能改善、恶化或新发。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study found that stress urinary incontinence surgery can either improve or worsen urgency urinary incontinence symptoms, or even cause de novo symptoms. During preoperative counseling, it is crucial to inform patients about these potential risks and emphasize the importance of ongoing assessment and management of urgency symptoms post-surgery.
items.limitation: 该研究为观察性研究，未能明确说明因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This observational study did not clearly establish causality.

items.title: Modifiable health-risk patterns among patients with back pain: a latent class analysis | BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders
items.summary: A latent class analysis identified modifiable health-risk patterns among patients with back pain, providing insights into comorbidity profiles.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用潜在类别分析揭示了背痛患者中可修改的健康风险模式。了解这些模式能帮助你更精准地识别和干预患者的共病风险，优化康复策略。
items.titleZh: 背痛患者中可修改的健康风险模式：一项潜在类别分析
items.summaryZh: 一项潜在类别分析在背痛患者中识别了可修改的健康风险模式，为共病概况提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: You need to identify comorbidity risks in back pain patients more precisely. This latent class analysis reveals multiple modifiable health-risk patterns. Understanding these patterns will help you tailor intervention plans and improve rehabilitation outcomes.
items.limitation: 潜在类别分析为观察性研究，无法直接建立因果关系，且结果可能受限于所纳入变量。
items.limitationEn: Latent class analysis is observational and cannot establish direct causality; results may be limited by included variables.

items.curatedReasonEn: To prevent muscle strains in sports more effectively and design return-to-sport programs, you must understand the actual situational characteristics of muscle strains. This blog post summarizes relevant research and will help you assess risks more precisely, avoiding ineffective interventions.

items.title: Associations of uric acid with wearable sensor-derived digital gait characteristics in older adults: vigor, symmetry, and stability | BMC Geriatrics
items.summary: A study found associations of uric acid levels with wearable sensor-derived digital gait characteristics (vigor, symmetry, and stability) in older adults.
items.curatedReason: 尿酸水平可能与老年人的步态活力、对称性和稳定性相关。这项研究提示，尿酸或许能作为识别步态异常高风险老年患者的生物标志物，值得你在临床中留意。
items.titleZh: 老年人尿酸与可穿戴传感器衍生的数字步态特征（活力、对称性和稳定性）的关联
items.summaryZh: 一项研究发现老年人的尿酸水平与可穿戴传感器衍生的数字步态特征（活力、对称性和稳定性）之间存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: Uric acid levels may be associated with gait vigor, symmetry, and stability in older adults. This study suggests that uric acid could serve as a biomarker to identify older patients at high risk for gait abnormalities, which is worth noting in your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法建立尿酸与步态特征之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish a causal relationship between uric acid and gait characteristics.

items.title: AOT study protocol of a randomised controlled trial
items.summary: The PAM-AOT study protocol outlines a randomized controlled trial investigating whether a pathological model can improve paretic hand abilities in hemiplegic children.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项随机对照试验的方案，旨在探讨病理模型能否改善偏瘫儿童患手能力。方案本身无法提供临床结论，但你应关注其未来研究结果，这可能为儿童偏瘫手部康复提供新思路。
items.titleZh: 病理模型能否改善偏瘫儿童患手能力？PAM-AOT 随机对照试验方案
items.summaryZh: PAM-AOT 研究方案概述了一项随机对照试验，旨在探讨病理模型能否改善偏瘫儿童的患手能力。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a protocol for an RCT investigating whether a pathological model can improve paretic hand abilities in hemiplegic children. While the protocol itself doesn't offer clinical conclusions, you should monitor its future results, as it may provide new insights for hand rehabilitation in pediatric hemiplegia.
items.limitation: 本研究仅为试验方案，尚未产生临床数据或结论。
items.limitationEn: This study is only a trial protocol and has not yet produced clinical data or conclusions.

items.title: Safety of Early Rehabilitation Dose After Stroke on Composite Outcomes: Analysis of Nationwide Japanese Medical Claims Data.
items.summary: This study analyzed Japanese medical claims data from 2018-2022 to evaluate the safety of early in-hospital rehabilitation (20-60 min/day initiated on days 1 or 2) after stroke in patients aged ≥ 18 years, finding no increased risk of adverse events.
items.curatedReason: 这项日本大型索赔数据分析提示，卒中后 1-2 天内早期康复是安全的，并无额外不良事件风险。你可以放心地在卒中急性期早期介入，无需担忧安全性问题。
items.titleZh: 卒中后早期康复剂量对复合结局的安全性的分析：日本全国医疗索赔数据。
items.summaryZh: 这项基于 2018-2022 年日本医疗索赔数据的大型观察研究评估了卒中后早期（1-2 天内开始，20-60 分钟/天）院内康复的安全性，发现其并无额外不良事件风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large Japanese claims data analysis suggests that early rehabilitation within 1-2 days post-stroke is safe, with no additional risk of adverse events. You can confidently intervene in the acute phase of stroke without safety concerns.
items.limitation: 本研究基于日本医保索赔数据，可能存在混杂因素，且结局指标仅限于安全性。
items.limitationEn: This study, based on Japanese medical claims data, may be subject to confounding factors, and the outcome measures were limited to safety.

items.curatedReasonEn: This WebPT case study suggests that RCM optimization can directly boost clinic revenue. If you haven't recently scrutinized your payment per visit, it's time to audit your RCM processes; don't leave those extra few dollars per visit on the table.

items.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.

items.titleZh: 膝关节置换术物理治疗管理临床实践指南：2026 年修订版

items.title: 国家中医药局、国家发展改革委负责同志就《中医药振兴发展“十五五”规划》答记者问-健康界

items.title: Long-term care insurance pilots and a severe care-gap proxy among older adults in China: evidence from CHARLS, 2011–2020 | BMC Geriatrics
items.summary: A research study from China, using CHARLS 2011–2020 data, investigated whether long-term care insurance pilots reduced a severe care-gap proxy among older adults, noting limited evidence on policy rollout reducing care gaps.
items.curatedReason: 这项来自中国的观察性研究表明，长期护理保险试点项目可能有助于减少功能受限老年人的护理缺口。作为康复专业人员，了解并积极参与这些政策的实施，对改善老年患者的康复可及性和长期照护至关重要。
items.titleZh: 中国长期护理保险试点与老年人严重护理缺口：CHARLS 2011–2020 证据
items.summaryZh: 一项来自中国的研究，利用 CHARLS 2011-2020 数据，调查了长期护理保险试点项目是否减少了老年人严重的护理缺口，指出政策实施对减少护理缺口的影响证据有限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study from China suggests that long-term care insurance pilot programs may help reduce care gaps for functionally limited older adults. items.title: Multimodal Phenotyping of Myofascial Pain Syndrome Using Rotational Shear Wave Elastography and Clinical Network Analysis
items.summary: A study involving 71 adults suggests that multi-angle shear wave elastography, combined with bioimpedance spectroscopy and patient-reported outcomes, can characterize upper-trapezius anisotropy and differentiate subgroups of myofascial pain syndrome, providing more objective phenotyping.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提示，旋转剪切波弹性成像 (SWE) 结合生物阻抗和患者报告结果，可以为肌筋膜疼痛综合征提供更客观、多模态的表型分析。这有助于未来精准诊断和个性化治疗方案。
items.titleZh: 多模态表型分析肌筋膜疼痛综合征：旋转剪切波弹性成像与临床网络分析的应用
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 71 名成年人的研究表明，多角度剪切波弹性成像结合生物阻抗谱和患者报告结果，可以表征斜方肌上部的各向异性，并区分肌筋膜疼痛综合征的亚组，提供更客观的表型分析。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that rotational shear wave elastography (SWE), combined with bioimpedance and patient-reported outcomes, can provide a more objective, multimodal phenotyping for myofascial pain syndrome. This aids in future precise diagnosis and personalized treatment.

items.limitationEn: This is an observational study with a relatively small sample size (n=71); larger cohort studies and clinical trials are needed to validate the diagnostic and prognostic value of these findings.

items.title: The effects of a falls prevention app (SAFE app) on community-dwelling adults' fall risk category: Single-blinded randomized control pilot trial.
items.summary: A single-blinded randomized controlled pilot trial (N=54) found that a 12-week app-based home exercise program, combined with educational pamphlets, positively impacted community-dwelling older adults' fall risk category compared to pamphlets alone.
items.curatedReason: 这款防跌倒 App 对社区老年人的跌倒风险分类有积极影响，但仅是小样本的初步试验，外推到大规模应用前需要更多证据。目前可作为辅助工具了解。
items.titleZh: 防跌倒 App（SAFE app）对社区老年人跌倒风险分类的影响：单盲随机对照初步试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单盲随机对照初步试验（N=54）发现，为期 12 周的基于 App 的家庭锻炼计划结合教育手册，相较于单独使用手册，对社区老年人的跌倒风险分类有积极影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This falls prevention app shows a positive impact on fall risk categorization in community-dwelling older adults. However, it's a small pilot trial, and more evidence is needed before widespread adoption. Consider it an assistive tool for now.
items.limitation: 这是一项小样本的初步试验（N=54），结果的外推性有限，且随访期较短。

items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示膝骨关节炎患者在平衡控制上可能过度依赖视觉和前庭系统。这提醒您评估这类患者时，注意其在本体感觉受损情况下的平衡代偿策略。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎老年患者静态平衡控制中的感觉整合策略

items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that patients with knee osteoarthritis may over-rely on visual and vestibular systems for balance control. This highlights the importance of assessing compensatory balance strategies in these patients, especially when proprioception is compromised.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性设计，样本量较小，且无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational study with a small sample size, and it cannot establish causality.
